notes: IFIP_SEC-X05_macaroons_strong (Phase P03, RQ1): implemented genuine caveat-bound capability baseline in evaluation/venue2027/ifip_sec/macaroon_adapter.py (MACAROON_ADAPTER_VERSION 1.0.0). MacaroonAdapter provides create_macaroon(root_key, identifier, location), add_first_party_caveat(macaroon, caveat), bind_proposal_lineage(macaroon, lineage_hash), and verify_macaroon(macaroon, root_key, check_context) -> MacaroonVerificationResult, plus target contract authorize(token, caveats, tx) -> Verdict. Implements full HMAC-SHA256 attenuation chain recomputation and constant-time verification. Enforces tenant, purpose, epoch, proposal lineage hash, and online checking. Separates offline-only mode as an explicit ablation where online-required caveats are rejected with ONLINE_CHECK_REQUIRED and offline vs online verifications are distinguished via online_checked. 24 unit/property tests covering positive controls (valid macaroons with purpose, epoch, lineage caveats verify cleanly; offline vs online check distinguished; authorize target contract; serialization roundtrip) and adversarial controls (tampered caveat breaks HMAC chain, expired caveat fails, lineage hash mismatch fails, offline check rejects online-required caveats, cross-purpose and cross-tenant fail closed, online revocation check rejects, short root key fails closed). uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean; python3 -m pytest -q exits 0.
